[Story]
Xiao Hong's mother is a very enlightened mother, Xiao Hong is a child with dreams and goals. Xiao Hong wins first place in the school's long-distance running competition, her mother Zhang Juan learns this news.

[Question]
Zhang Juan should be proud of Xiao Hong, but why does she look a little sad?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Zhang Juan thinks of her deceased husband who is the champion of the school, so she feels sad.
B. Zhang Juan does not like the school's teachers, so she feels dissatisfied with this competition.
C. Zhang Juan wants Xiao Hong to give up sports and focus on artistic creation, Xiao Hong's rebellion makes her feel sad.
D. Because Zhang Juan is the runner-up in the school, so she envies Xiao Hong for winning the championship. The sadness is her jealousy.
